item.title: Vietnam: Institutional Reform Drives Hanoi’s Smart Development
item.description: Hanoi’s development requires a strong legal framework, institutional reform and a clear focus on digital transformation, science, technology, innovation, creativity and sustainability to drive high-quality growth.

item.title: Hong Kong Expands Urban Trials to Advance Intelligent Mobility
item.description: Hong Kong is expanding real-world autonomous vehicle trials across urban districts, rigorously testing advanced mobility technologies to improve traffic efficiency, enhance road safety and ensure reliability under local conditions.

item.title: The Philippines: DICT Strengthens Digital Access for Learners
item.description: DICT’s Bayanihan SIM Project is actively enhancing digital access for students and teachers in remote communities of Soccsksargen and Davao Region, bridging the connectivity gap and supporting online learning.

item.title: Singapore, Japan Sign Landmark Quantum Cooperation Agreement
item.description: The first government-level quantum cooperation agreement establishes a framework to advance research, talent development and commercialisation across the regional quantum ecosystem.

item.title: Malaysia Strengthens Digital Infrastructure Development in Sabah
item.description: Malaysia is expanding digital infrastructure in Sabah, focusing on connectivity, education technology and cybersecurity to address regional gaps and support inclusive development.

item.title: Australia: Advancing Smart Energy Storage for Tropical Conditions
item.description: Australia’s CSIRO is studying how heat and humidity affect battery energy storage performance in tropical regions, guiding safe, reliable and climate-appropriate renewable energy infrastructure deployment.

item.title: The Philippines Introduces AI Literacy as a Life Skill in Schools
item.description: The Philippines has officially launched Project AGAP.AI to introduce artificial intelligence literacy in basic education, equipping students and educators to use AI responsibly as digital transformation accelerates.

item.title: Hong Kong PolyU’s Magnetic Textiles for Smart Wearables
item.description: PolyU researchers developed lightweight magnetorheological textiles enabling programmable, human-safe fibre deformation, advancing smart wearables, soft robotics and immersive haptic technologies.

item.title: Vietnam: Five Strategic Breakthroughs to Drive Digital Economy
item.description: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh has called for five strategic breakthroughs in digital data development to make data a high-value national asset, strengthen security and drive Vietnam’s digital economy.

item.title: Singapore Health Information Bill Enhances Care Coordination
item.description: Singapore’s Health Information Bill establishes a legal framework for secure, interoperable health data sharing, strengthening digital infrastructure and enabling coordinated care across the healthcare system.
